name: Les Deux Alpes
description: Les Deux Alpes has the largest skiable glacier in Europe (6km long, 1,200m vertical) — one of the few resorts in the world with summer skiing from June to September. The resort sits on a plateau between two valleys ('Deux Alpes'), purpose-built in the 1960s but now one of the best snowparks in Europe. Lively, young, vibrant. The glacier offers year-round skiing, the snowpark is legendary (boardercross, halfpipe, kickers), and there's a huge range of non-ski activities.

overview.atmosphere: Glacier skiing capital of the Alps. Europe's largest skiable glacier (summer skiing June-Sept). Legendary snowpark, lively young crowd, purpose-built.

when_to_go.season_open: Late Nov to early May + summer skiing June-Sept

beyond_skiing.ice_skating: Open-air ice rink in the heart of resort, beside Saga Centre (Rue des Sagnes)
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Paragliding, ice climbing, speed riding, electric mountain biking, glacier hiking with guides (from March), 70+ restaurants, night skiing on Vallée Blanche green run

villages.name: Les Deux Alpes
villages.character: Main resort — lively, young, purpose-built with shops, bars, restaurants along main street

honest_drawbacks: Main street can feel crowded with young crowds
Apres is fun but limited to a handful of bars
High winds can close glacier (frequent in winter)
Long transfer from Grenoble (1h45 mountain road)
